title: 日本ダービーの後に・リーズン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket wins the Japanese Derby, and Biwa Hayahide is terrified by how easily her friend renders her calculations meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her numerous calculations, Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin both have something that keeps defying her estimations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If so, then we just have to factor that "something" into the equation. Doing so without knowing what we're dealing with is reckless, but Biwa Hayahide comes up with a hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She realizes she lacks the iron will to improve and asks me to increase her training intensity to avoid defeat at the Kikuka Sho.
